manifest.name: GitHub
manifest.author: Yggdrasil
manifest.description: 查仓库、issue、README 与用户；填了 Token 才能建 issue（不填也能只读查询）。

fields.label: Personal Access Token（可选）
fields.hint: 不填也能用：匿名每分钟 10 次、每小时 60 次。填一个 fine-grained token（只勾读权限即可）会变成每小时 5000 次，并且**只有填了**才能创建 issue。把令牌放在请求头里，它不会出现在提示词里。

endpoints.name: rate_limit
endpoints.label: 剩余额度
endpoints.description: How many API calls are left and when the window resets: resources.core.{limit,remaining,reset}. Call it when a request comes back 403/429, or to check whether the token in the plugin panel is actually being used (without a token the limit is 60/h, with one it is 5000/h).

endpoints.name: search_repos
endpoints.label: 搜仓库
endpoints.description: Search repositories. q accepts GitHub search syntax (e.g. "netease music", "language:rust stars:>1000", "topic:cli"). Returns total_count and items[] with full_name, description, stargazers_count, language, html_url, owner.login, updated_at, license.spdx_id.

params.name: q
params.description: search terms, GitHub search syntax allowed

endpoints.emptyHint: total_count 0: nothing matched that query. Simplify it (drop qualifiers) or try the owner/name directly. HTTP 403 with "rate limit" means the anonymous quota is used up — fill a token in the plugin panel or wait for the reset time from github.rate_limit.

endpoints.name: repo
endpoints.label: 仓库详情
endpoints.description: One repository: full_name, description, stargazers_count, forks_count, open_issues_count, language, license.spdx_id, default_branch, pushed_at, html_url, topics. owner and repo come from a search hit (full_name splits into them).
endpoints.emptyHint: HTTP 404: this owner/repo does not exist (check the spelling) or is private. Report it; do not retry.

endpoints.name: repo_issues
endpoints.label: issue 列表
endpoints.description: Issues of a repository, newest first: number, title, state, user.login, labels[].name, comments, created_at, html_url. **This endpoint also returns pull requests** — an entry is a PR when pull_request is not null; filter those out unless the user wants them. One page is per_page items; use page to go further.
endpoints.emptyHint: An empty array means no issues in that state. Widen state to all, or check that the repo name is right.

endpoints.name: repo_readme
endpoints.label: README 原文
endpoints.description: The repository README as **plain markdown text** (not JSON). Use it to answer "what is this project / how do I install it". It can be long — quote the relevant few lines into a component instead of dumping all of it.
endpoints.emptyHint: HTTP 404: this repository has no README (or the name is wrong). Say so instead of guessing its content.

endpoints.name: user
endpoints.label: 用户资料
endpoints.description: A GitHub user or organisation: login, name, bio, company, location, blog, public_repos, followers, following, created_at, avatar_url, html_url.
endpoints.emptyHint: HTTP 404: no such user. Check the spelling.

endpoints.name: create_issue
endpoints.label: 建 issue
endpoints.description: **Create an issue** in a repository. Needs the token field filled in. Give owner, repo, title and optionally body. Returns the created issue (number, html_url, state). **Only do this when the user explicitly asked for it** — this is visible to everyone watching that repository and cannot be undone from here. After creating it, show the user the number and the html_url.
endpoints.emptyHint: HTTP 401/403 means the token is missing, expired, or lacks issue permission — tell the user to check the token field, and do not retry. HTTP 410/404 means issues are disabled or the repo does not exist.

example.title: 来自 Yggdrasil 的测试 issue
example.body: 如果你看到这条，说明插件能写。

guide:
# github

Browse GitHub through its public API, and (with a token) create issues.

## About the token field

- **It is optional.** Without it every read-only operation here still works, but you get **60 requests per hour**
  for the anonymous IP (and 10 per minute for search). With a fine-grained token it becomes 5000 per hour.
- **`create_issue` needs it.** Without a token that call returns 401/403 — tell the user to fill the token field
  instead of retrying.
- The token is sent as an `Authorization` header by the plugin. **Never print it, never put it in a component,
  and never ask the user to paste it into the chat** — it belongs in the plugin panel only.

## What you can do

| Question | Operations |
| --- | --- |
| "找一下 xxx 的仓库" | `search_repos` |
| "facebook/react 是什么项目、多少 star" | `repo` |
| "这个项目怎么装 / 是干什么的" | `repo_readme` |
| "有什么还没关的 issue" | `repo_issues` |
| "torvalds 是谁" | `user` |
| "帮我提一个 issue" | `create_issue` (needs token) |
| "还能调几次" | `rate_limit` |

## Rules

- **`owner` and `repo` are separate parameters.** A search result gives you `full_name` like
  `facebook/react` — split it: owner=`facebook`, repo=`react`.
- **`repo_issues` also returns pull requests.** An entry is a PR when `pull_request.url` is non-null.
  Filter them out unless the user asked for PRs, and say which you filtered if it changes the count.
- **Rate limits are real and easy to hit.** Search is 10/minute unauthenticated. If a call returns 403 or 429,
  call `rate_limit`, report `remaining` and the reset time, and **stop** — do not retry in a loop.
- **`repo_readme` is plain markdown, not JSON.** Do not try to parse it as JSON. Quote the lines that answer
  the question (install / usage / what it is) rather than dumping thousands of characters into a window.
- **Numbers change between calls** (stars, issue counts). Report what the response said, with no "currently" if
  you are not sure when it was fetched; the response has the timestamps (`pushed_at`, `created_at`).
- Keep windows compact: a repo card (name, description, stars, language, link) or a short issue list beats a dump.

## create_issue — treat it as a real-world action

It posts to a public repository. Therefore:

1. **Only when the user explicitly asked** for an issue ("帮我提一个 issue"). Never "helpfully" file one.
2. **Show them the exact title and body first** and get a yes, unless they already dictated both.
3. Right after it succeeds, show the issue **number and html_url** so they can open it.
4. If it fails with 401/403, say it is a token/permission problem. Do not try a different URL or method.

## Failure modes

- **404** → wrong owner/repo (or private). Report it; check the spelling from a search result.
- **403 / 429** → rate limit or missing permission. Use `rate_limit`, then stop.
- **422 on create_issue** → the repo has issues disabled, or the title is empty. Report the API message.
- Empty array from `repo_issues` → genuinely no issues in that state; try `state: all` once.
